description: A sixteen by sixteen matrix mixer: every input can be sent to every output at its own level

params.text: Sets how much of that input goes into that output, 0 to 1

inputs.text: One of the sixteen signals to be mixed, one channel per voice
Scales the whole of one output column by cable: channel Y of this jack scales what input Y contributes to that output, 0-10V across nothing to full

outputs.text: Carries the sum of the sixteen inputs at the levels set down its column

notes: an output with no cable in it is not computed at all, and an input with no cable counts as silence
the channel count of every output is that of whichever input carries the most channels

inputs.16:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads full level; a negative voltage does nothing here.
